slide1.label: AUTOMATIC TRACKING
slide1.title: Ditch the paper logbook.
slide1.body: Enter your MMSI and SeaTime Tracker picks up AIS positions automatically. Your sea service builds in the background while you focus on the job.

slide2.label: MCA-COMPLIANT REPORTS
slide2.title: CoC-ready at the tap of a button.
slide2.body: Export sea service testimonials in the format the MCA actually requires. PDF or CSV, signed and ready to submit with your next Notice of Eligibility.

slide3.label: BUILT BY MARINERS
slide3.title: By Foreland Marine.
slide3.body: We build Lightship ISM for fleet managers. SeaTime Tracker puts the same standards into the hands of individual officers and engineers.

soleWatch.title: Sole watchkeeper
soleWatch.bodyEngineer: If you are the only engineer on this vessel, every day at sea is also a day of watchkeeping.
soleWatch.bodyBridge: If you are the only watchkeeper on the bridge on this vessel, every day at sea is also a day of watchkeeping.
soleWatch.testimonialNoteEngineer: Ask the master to state on your testimonial or sea service letter that you were the sole engineer and kept the watch each day at sea.
soleWatch.testimonialNoteBridge: Ask the master to state on your testimonial or sea service letter that you were the sole watchkeeper on the bridge and kept the watch each day at sea.
soleWatch.onAll: On for all service on this vessel
soleWatch.onTitle: Count earlier service on {{vessel}} as watchkeeping?
soleWatch.onIntroEngineer: Only turn this on if you are the only engineer on board, so you keep the watch every day at sea.
soleWatch.onIntroBridge: Only turn this on if you are the only watchkeeper on the bridge, so you keep the watch every day at sea.
soleWatch.offTitle: When did you stop being the sole watchkeeper?
soleWatch.offIntro: Days up to and including that date stay as watchkeeping days.
soleWatch.addsNone: No earlier days added. Days at sea from now on will count.
soleWatch.previewFailed: Could not work out the days.
soleWatch.notSaved: Could not update this vessel. Please try again.

screen.title: Sole watchkeeping
screen.intro: Days of actual sea service inside these dates also count as watchkeeping days (MCA, MNZ and SAMSA). Periods on the same vessel cannot overlap.
screen.notApplies: Your maritime authority does not count sole watchkeeping, so these dates are kept but not used.
screen.noVessels: Add a vessel to record sole watchkeeping.
